method: Complete program source counts exclude shared entry/timing drivers; C++ also reports function-only counts. Same generated C timing driver for NIL/C++; flat typed entry bridges; separate translation units without LTO; NIL O0/O2, C++ O2 -fwrapv. Python timed loop includes result comparison. Copying transformations preserve immutable value semantics. All timed numeric intermediates fit i64; Python general overflow/division semantics are not claimed equivalent. Sorted search inputs are unique. Timings exclude process launch, compilation and input parsing; include marshaling, result comparison and call overhead. Build-stage figures are single samples per level, not compile-time distributions. Signature alternatives are tokenizer screens, not implemented parsers or generation/TCR evidence.
